name: Milford Summer Playground Program
description_short: A city run outdoor playground program held weekdays from 9 am to 4 pm at two Milford school sites, Mathewson and Live Oaks. Children play sports and games, do arts and crafts, go to the movies most Tuesdays and take a trip to Beardsley Zoo.
special_needs_notes: The department says this program is not set up for children with special needs and points families to its Camp Happiness program. Children must be potty trained.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests by email to the program director. No refunds for missed days or weeks. Full refund less a processing fee up to four weeks before the June 29 start; requests within those four weeks carry a 25% fee.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 handbook: Monday to Friday June 29 to August 7, 9 am to 4 pm, check in from 8:30, no program Friday July 3. No childcare before or after, no transportation, children bring lunch. Sites are Mathewson and Live Oaks; parents choose. Optional Lake Compounce trip costs $55 extra. Email is the program director's. The handbook gives no ages or fee.

Researched by Claude from this page. The department's facility list gives Mathewson School at 466 W River St, Milford 06460, and Live Oaks School at 575 Merwin Ave, Milford 06460, the two program sites.

for_andrew: The program runs at two sites with the same dates and hours (Mathewson School, 466 West River Street, and Live Oaks School, 575 Merwin Avenue). I made one listing at Mathewson. One listing, or one per site?

The 2026 handbook gives no ages or fee, and the program pages are down for the off season. A 2019 brochure on the same site said Milford residents ages 6 to 12 only. List without ages and price, or wait for 2027?
